item.title: What HubSpot's onboarding fee actually buys you
item.description: HubSpot's mandatory onboarding fee runs from $1,500 to $7,000 depending on the hub and tier. Here is what is inside it, when it is worth paying, and the two situations where a partner can deliver the same scope instead.
